entities.summary: Anant Kakba Priolkar was an Indian polemicist, writer and political activist. He was elected as the President of the Akhil Bharatiya Marathi Sahitya Sammelan held in 1951 at Karwar, Karnataka, India. His book The Goa Inquisition (1961) remains his bestselling work. He died in Maharashtra in 1973.
